text:
marta: Heads up — PR #4321 adds an SDK example for region headers and mentions FIPS-country mapping. I pushed a small tweak to the snippet, but want legal and i18n eyes before merging.

devon: where's the snippet living? link? :eyes:

marta: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321/files — file is docs/guides/geo-sdk-examples.md (bottom). It's a JS + curl example.

ana: quick note — we shouldn't expose internal 'fips' variable name in public sample; use `country_code` instead. tiny phrasing change.

ana: also need to clarify residency vs routing: header indicates preferred region but not data residency guarantee. add one sentence.

jin: LGTM on legal side, but we need to add the exact wording we agreed on for residency: "Requests routed to a regional endpoint do not imply data residency unless you have a dedicated residency contract with Redwood." Can you add?

marta: adding that exact sentence now.

devon: snippet question — metadata header should be `X-Redwood-Region` (case preserved for clarity). current example uses `x-region`. I'll update to `X-Redwood-Region` to match SDK enum.

marta: thanks. I'll also replace the FIPS mapping with this note: "We recommend using ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes (e.g., US, GB). Some customers map older FIPS codes internally — we don't accept FIPS as canonical input in the public API."

docs-bot: Deploy preview built for PR #4321 at https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/4321 — netlify.

ana: can we add a minimal cURL example for the header? 1-2 lines. Users often copy the curl directly.

marta: adding curl snippet and marking the JS example as "advanced". new snippet:```bash
curl -H 'X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

jin: thanks — please add the residency sentence right above that curl so legal wording is visible.

marta: done and pushed. Also added a small footnote with link to the residency FAQ: https://redwood.company/residency-faq.

devon: one last ask — update SDK reference to the v1.3.0 client which includes the region enum. Otherwise snippet could confuse older SDK users.

marta: updated PR description to call out required SDK >= v1.3.0.

ana: I'll run a quick i18n sweep to ensure translations won't mistakenly change header names.

marta: thanks all. leaving the final merge to devon once CI passes and i18n has the sweep. :white_check_mark:
